content.text:
Implemented. Live is now a first-class chat mode.

- The chat composer has a visible **Live** action. Missing credentials open the appropriate key prompt.
- The in-chat live surface supports audio, camera/screen preview, live transcripts, interruption/error states, and dictation fallback.
- Ending Live writes both sides of the transcript into the active chat, so text and voice share one conversation history.
- The dedicated `/live` page remains available, but it is no longer the primary entry point.
- Fixed the mobile overlay so chat navigation cannot cover its controls.

Changed [AssistantChatPanel.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/components/AssistantChatPanel.tsx:702), with transcript handling in [live-transcript.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/keating/live-transcript.ts:1) and tests in [live-transcript.test.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/test/live-transcript.test.ts:9).

Validation passed:

- 617 web tests
- TypeScript check
- Production Vite + Nitro build
- Rendered desktop and 390px mobile checks
- Audio-only, camera-preview, missing-key, and permission-error states

A real provider-backed audio session was not exercised because no usable provider credential/media device was available in the headless test browser. The required `vet` review was attempted repeatedly, but its normal path lacked an Anthropic credential and its local Codex fallback stalled without output.
